stem.text: A flat plate is positively charged and a curved plate is negatively charged.
Which diagram shows the electric field lines between the two plates?

A.alt: Straight vertical field lines between a flat upper plate marked with + signs and a curved lower plate marked with negative signs, with arrowheads pointing downwards.

B.alt: Straight vertical field lines between a flat upper plate marked with + signs and a curved lower plate marked with negative signs, with arrowheads pointing upwards.

C.alt: Curved field lines between a flat upper plate marked with + signs and a curved lower plate marked with negative signs, with arrowheads pointing downwards.

D.alt: Curved field lines between a flat upper plate marked with + signs and a curved lower plate marked with negative signs, with arrowheads pointing upwards.
